nodes.name: Zalo Message Trigger
nodes.notes: Trigger nay lang nghe tin nhan moi trong nhom Zalo. Can chon credential zaloApi da tao sau khi dang nhap QR.

nodes.name: Normalize Zalo Message
nodes.notes: Node nay loc chi tin nhan text va dua ve schema gon gang de gui sang Gemini.

values.content:
={{"Analyze this Zalo group message and return ONLY valid JSON. Do not use markdown, do not add explanation.

Return exactly these keys: thread_id, group_name, sender_id, sender_name, message_text, message_ts, summary, category, intent, action_required, action_type, customer_name, phone, address, product, quantity, unit, amount, due_date, priority, confidence.

Rules:
- category must be one of: order, support, feedback, internal, other
- action_type must be one of: new_order, update_order, complaint, question, follow_up, other
- priority must be one of: low, medium, high
- action_required must be true or false
- quantity and amount must be numbers, use 0 if missing
- confidence must be a number from 0 to 1
- due_date must be ISO date if known, otherwise empty string
- Keep Vietnamese text natural in summary and intent
- Copy thread_id, group_name, sender_id, sender_name, message_text, message_ts from the input context exactly

Input context:
thread_id: " + $json.threadId + "
group_name: " + $json.groupName + "
sender_id: " + $json.senderId + "
sender_name: " + $json.senderName + "
message_ts: " + $json.messageTs + "
message_text: " + $json.messageText}}

options.systemMessage: You are a strict data extraction engine for Vietnamese Zalo group messages. Your job is to convert unstructured chat into structured JSON for Google Sheets.

nodes.name: Google Gemini
nodes.notes: Gan credential googlePalmApi cho node nay va paste Gemini API key.

nodes.name: Parse Gemini JSON
nodes.notes: Node nay parse JSON tu Gemini va flatten thanh cac cot de ghi vao Google Sheets.

nodes.name: Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Doi YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID thanh ID file Sheet cua ban, sau do gan credential Google Sheets OAuth2.
